nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders an agent chat message bubble with streaming state, height-clamping for long responses, and a show-more/less footer.

nodes.name: resolveAgentMessageClampEligibility
nodes.summary: Determines whether a streamed agent message is eligible for height-clamping based on group position and fallback flag.

nodes.name: shouldShowAgentMessageFooter
nodes.summary: Computes whether the show-more/less footer should be displayed for an agent message given its clamp and expansion state.

nodes.name: AgentMessageBlock
nodes.summary: React component rendering an agent chat message with streaming indicator, optional height clamp, and a footer for expanding long content.

nodes.name: A2UIActionContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines a React context and provider for passing A2UI action callbacks and the session id down through the canvas rendering tree.

nodes.name: useA2UIAction
nodes.summary: Hook that reads the A2UI action context, giving canvas elements access to the current action callback and session id.

nodes.name: A2UIActionProvider
nodes.summary: Provider component that supplies the A2UI action callback and session id to descendant canvas elements via context.

nodes.name: A2UIRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Streaming-aware renderer that parses A2UI protocol lines into interactive elements and exposes an imperative handle for the surrounding canvas card.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses React forwardRef to expose an imperative surface handle to the parent CanvasPreviewSurface.

nodes.name: buildMessages
nodes.summary: Builds the message list passed to the A2UI processor from parsed elements and prior conversation state.

nodes.name: useSurface
nodes.summary: Internal hook managing the A2UI surface's rendered elements and re-processing them as new content streams in.

nodes.name: A2UIRenderer
nodes.summary: forwardRef component that renders parsed A2UI elements and exposes an imperative handle for the parent canvas surface.

nodes.name: CanvasErrorBoundary.tsx
nodes.summary: Class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors inside the canvas preview surface and shows a fallback UI instead of crashing the chat.

nodes.name: CanvasErrorBoundary
nodes.summary: React error boundary class that catches errors thrown while rendering canvas content and renders a fallback UI.

nodes.name: CanvasPreviewSurface.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the live canvas preview surface, handling static HTML iframe rendering, non-embeddable URL notices, and delegating to the A2UI or React artifact runners.
nodes.languageNotes: forwardRef component exposing a CanvasPreviewSurfaceHandle to callers.

nodes.name: StaticHtmlCanvas
nodes.summary: Renders static HTML canvas content inside a sandboxed iframe using the extracted HTML body and styles.

nodes.name: NonEmbeddedUrlNotice
nodes.summary: Renders a notice explaining that a given URL cannot be embedded in the canvas, with a link to open it externally.

nodes.name: CanvasPreviewSurface
nodes.summary: forwardRef component that renders the live canvas preview - static HTML, A2UI, or React artifact - based on content type.

nodes.name: ReactArtifactRunner.tsx
nodes.summary: Compiles and executes React component source code live within the canvas using react-live, normalizing snippet source before evaluation.

nodes.name: normalizeReactLiveSource
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw React component source code (imports, exports) so it can be evaluated by react-live inside the canvas.

nodes.name: ReactArtifactRunner
nodes.summary: Component that compiles and renders live React artifact source code within the canvas, surfacing compile/runtime errors.

nodes.name: a2uiElements.tsx
nodes.summary: Component library and line-based parser for the A2UI declarative UI protocol, rendering headings, text, buttons, tables, charts and forms from parsed content.

nodes.name: cssTextToStyle
nodes.summary: Converts an inline CSS text string into a React style object usable by A2UI element components.

nodes.name: HtmlEl
nodes.summary: Renders a raw-HTML A2UI element inside a sanitized container.

nodes.name: ButtonEl
nodes.summary: Renders a clickable A2UI button element that dispatches an action through the A2UI action context.

nodes.name: ListEl
nodes.summary: Renders a list A2UI element, mapping its items to individual rendered rows.

nodes.name: TableEl
nodes.summary: Renders a tabular A2UI element with header and row data.

nodes.name: ChartEl
nodes.summary: Renders a chart A2UI element (bar/line/pie) using the parsed chart configuration and data series.

nodes.name: FormEl
nodes.summary: Renders a form A2UI element with input fields and a submit button that dispatches a form-submit action.

nodes.name: renderA2UIElement
nodes.summary: Dispatches a parsed A2UI element node to its corresponding renderer component based on element type.

nodes.name: parseA2UILines
nodes.summary: Parses raw A2UI protocol lines into structured element objects for rendering.

nodes.name: canvasPreviewPolicy.ts
nodes.summary: Policy helpers that classify canvas payload content (static HTML vs A2UI vs URL) and split mixed A2UI/HTML content into separate render blocks.

nodes.name: getCanvasPreviewRenderKind
nodes.summary: Classifies a canvas payload as static HTML, A2UI, or URL content to decide which renderer to use.

nodes.name: splitA2UIContent
nodes.summary: Splits mixed content into separate A2UI and non-A2UI segments so each can be rendered by the appropriate block.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level canvas inline card that renders an inline artifact/canvas surface within chat (React artifacts, static HTML, or A2UI), wrapped in an error boundary with a loading skeleton.

nodes.name: CanvasLoadingSkeleton
nodes.summary: Renders a placeholder loading skeleton shown while canvas content is being prepared.

nodes.name: CanvasInlineCard
nodes.summary: Core canvas inline card component that selects and renders the appropriate canvas surface (React artifact, static HTML, or A2UI) for the given mode.

nodes.name: CanvasInlineCardWithBoundary
nodes.summary: Wraps CanvasInlineCard in the CanvasErrorBoundary so rendering failures degrade gracefully; this is the module's default export.

nodes.name: openInSimulatorCanvas.ts
nodes.summary: Helper that dispatches a request to open canvas content inside the simulator's live canvas panel, used when jumping from chat to the simulator view.

nodes.name: openInSimulatorCanvas
nodes.summary: Dispatches a request to open the given canvas payload inside the simulator's live canvas panel for a session.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript type definitions for the canvas inline card system - payload shapes, render modes, and A2UI element types used across the canvas rendering pipeline.

nodes.name: useJumpToSimulatorCanvas.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that wires up a click handler to jump from a chat canvas card into the simulator's live canvas view for the current session and payload.

nodes.name: useJumpToSimulatorCanvas
nodes.summary: Hook returning a click handler that opens the current canvas payload in the simulator canvas for the active session.

nodes.name: CodePreview.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal preview panel that renders code as a live HTML document for HTML snippets or as syntax-highlighted code, triggered from the chat code block.

nodes.name: buildHtmlDoc
nodes.summary: Builds a full standalone HTML document string from code content for rendering inside the preview iframe.

nodes.name: CodePreview
nodes.summary: Slide-over modal component that renders code as a live HTML preview or syntax-highlighted source, and is the module's default export.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Style and language configuration for the chat code block - maps file extensions/languages to display names and defines shared visual styling tokens.

nodes.name: getLanguageDisplayName
nodes.summary: Looks up the human-readable display name for a given language identifier.

nodes.name: detectLanguageFromPath
nodes.summary: Infers a syntax-highlighting language identifier from a file path's extension.

nodes.name: diffParser.ts
nodes.summary: Parses unified diff text into structured hunks/segments for rendering diffs in chat, including hunk-header parsing and diff truncation for large diffs.

nodes.name: parseHunkHeader
nodes.summary: Parses a unified-diff hunk header line into starting line numbers and line counts.

nodes.name: parseUnifiedDiff
nodes.summary: Parses a full unified diff string into structured hunks and line segments for rendering.

nodes.name: truncateDiff
nodes.summary: Truncates a large unified diff to a maximum number of visible lines for performant rendering.
